name: table
title: Table
description: HBD data table: real <table role=grid> with sortable headers (hbd:sort -> onSort with {key,direction} + aria-sort ascending/descending/none), optional row selection via a leading checkbox column (select-all + per-row, hbd:selection-change -> onSelectionChange with {selected}), three row-height sizes (sm/md/lg), striped/bordered variants, sticky header and sticky first column. Data is driven by the columns + rows props (the WC's JS-property API). Sorting + selection are controlled-first (sortKey/sortDir + onSort, selected + onSelectionChange) with uncontrolled fallbacks (defaultSortKey/defaultSortDir/defaultSelected). Carries the WC ARIA verbatim: role=grid/row/columnheader/gridcell, aria-rowcount/colcount, aria-rowindex, aria-selected, aria-multiselectable, plus the full roving-tabindex grid keyboard pattern (arrows/Home/End, Enter/Space to sort).
